overview_markdown:
LobsterAI is an open-source desktop agent built by NetEase Youdao, positioned as an all-scenario office assistant. Architecturally it splits into two layers: Cowork, the product/session layer handling local persistence, permissions, UI state, artifacts, agents, memory, and IM bindings; and OpenClaw, which serves as the underlying runtime and gateway for agent execution. It ships as an Electron 43 + React 18 app for macOS and Windows with downloadable installers.

Its differentiators are desktop-grade tool use (local files, terminal, browser workflows, documents, spreadsheets, slides) with approval prompts before sensitive actions, multi-agent workflows with per-agent identity/model/skills, Expert Kits for scenario-specific capabilities, and remote control from a phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and Telegram. Recent work shows active hardening: passkey/WebAuthn support in the in-app browser, scheduled-task fixes for Weixin delivery, and removal of the background jobs feature.

Compared to running OpenClaw directly, LobsterAI trades leanness for usability — a full GUI, installers, and IM integrations — but adds commercial elements like subscription trials and quota tracking, and remains desktop-only. It is best viewed as a polished OpenClaw distribution for office productivity rather than an independent agent framework.
